label: For "IT Agent Evaluation Harness": Evaluate IT assistants and agents on real past tickets and incidents with expected outcomes, safety scenarios and cost so changes to prompts, tools and models are judged on evidence before rollout. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Model-written answers as truth.
